name: West Australian Networks
summary: WA-owned ISP trading as 'Westnet' on westnet.net.au — unrelated to Westnet (westnet.com.au, bought by iiNet); dialup, ISDN, ADSL2+, mobile broadband, VoIP, hosting and web design, with a focus on rural, regional and remote areas; TIO and WAIA member; defunct c. 2012-13.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of westnet.net.au Dec 1998; company claimed to have provided Internet and IT services since 1995.
Last live Wayback capture Aug 2012; domain returned 302/403 from early 2013 and is now dead.
